title: Util.isError has been removed
summary: Node.js removed util.isError (DEP0048: documentation-only since v4.0.0, runtime deprecation since v22.0.0, end-of-life since v23.0.0).

constraints: Keep the behavior of the code unchanged; check the replacement's argument and return-value differences.

steps.title: Replace the usage
steps.instructions: Replace each reported use of util.isError with Error.isError(arg).

verification.purpose: Run the repository tests when defined.
